blocks.text: The leaders of the United States, China and Russia were set to hold their first-ever trilateral summit in Shenzhen on Thursday to discuss key international security issues, while uncertainty remains over whether US President Donald Trump will meet North Korean leader Kim Jong-un during his visit to China. Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin will meet on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit in Shenzhen later in the day. Trump has expressed his intention to discuss nuclear arms reductions and other major international issues at the three-way summit. The meeting comes amid differences among the […]...
